title: Full road network from the user's map

items.name: Trace ref_40 roads: Sato ridge filter on a road-likeness channel, hysteresis, skeleton, graph, spur pruning, gap bridging (tools/v2/maproads/trace.py, vectorize.py)

Main roads re-routed along the picture's own roads (least-cost path on the traced raster): ring motorway, US-27, SR 49, CR 720, A1A, CR 64, CR 41, US-41, plus new Pond Apple Expressway (SR 951) and Sabal Grove Parkway (SR 945)
Traced rural network (roads of 700 m or more, 359 km) fed through tools/world/build.py section 4b; 4 extra ring interchanges; merged and published (b20261114-011057)
Towns: exact street counts from ref_40, 90-150 m blocks, Main Street with shop frontage, free town-square block
items.evidence: docs/v2/reports/maproads-town-counts.json: 31 of 32 match (Junonia 2x3 on the map, 2x2 in game)

items.name: Every town and island reachable by road from downtown with no step, wall or missing link (headless A*)
Interchanges: no lips over 0.15 m (probe across every ramp and the motorway within 450 m)
items.evidence: docs/v2/reports/maproads-interchange-probe.json (b20261114-032612): 8276 samples, 353 off-height, 103 steps; median-flyover junctions replaced by diamonds (tools/world/wl/roadnet.py diamond_end), deck profiles rebased onto the terrain; remaining problems sit on the hilly west side of the ring (about x -15700, z -4600 to -9600) where a ramp deck is missing (17 m drops) and the lane collider stays flat while the game height sampler follows the slope
